name: functions
description: Cloud Functions for Firebase: ingestion pipeline (mask, match, extract, verify, resolve, judge), seed and admin callables.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=lib/index.js --external:firebase-admin --external:firebase-admin/* --external:firebase-functions --external:firebase-functions/* --external:@anthropic-ai/sdk --external:@anthropic-ai/sdk/* --external:zod --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
